name: Metascript Rod, Intensify
body:
Aura strong (no design); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.; Price varies; 3,000 gp (lesser), 11,000 gp (normal), 24,500 gp (greater)

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three scripts per day that are intensified as though using the Intensify Script feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Intensify Script; Cost varies; 1,500 gp (lesser), 5,500 gp (normal), 12,250 gp (greater)
